Alex Carter — Software Engineer

About Me

Senior Software Engineer · Backend & Distributed Systems

I'm a software engineer with over 8 years of experience designing and building reliable, scalable backend systems. I enjoy turning ambiguous problems into clean, maintainable code, mentoring junior engineers, and collaborating closely with product teams to ship things people actually use. Outside of work I contribute to open-source tooling and tinker with home-grown robotics projects.

Download CV (PDF)

Skills

Languages

Python

Go

JavaScript / TypeScript

Infrastructure

Kubernetes & Docker

AWS

Terraform

Practices

System Design

CI/CD

Mentoring & Code Review

Work Experience

  1. Senior Software Engineer — Northwind Systems

    2021 — Present · Portland, OR

    Lead backend engineer for a distributed order-processing platform handling 2M+ transactions daily. Redesigned the event pipeline to cut latency by 40% and mentored a team of five engineers.

  2. Software Engineer — Brightline Labs

    2018 — 2021 · Seattle, WA

    Built and maintained internal APIs serving the customer analytics dashboard. Migrated legacy monolith services to containerized microservices on Kubernetes.

  3. Junior Developer — Cascade Web Studio

    2016 — 2018 · Portland, OR

    Developed client-facing web applications and contributed to a shared component library used across a dozen client projects.

Get In Touch

Whether you have a role you think I'd be a good fit for, a project you'd like to discuss, or just want to say hello, I'd love to hear from you. Fill out the form or reach me directly using the details below.

  • Email: alex.carter@example.com
  • Phone: +1 (555) 123-4567
  • Location: Portland, OR
  • LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/alexcarter
